facts.value: To impart communicative and intercultural foreign language skills, refresh and complete existing basic knowledge of the Spanish language.
Two levels are offered: Basic knowledge or completion of level A1 of the GER or 40 – 60 points in the placement test.

In the course Business Spanish 1 - Base, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the Spanish language, as well as insights into the country, its society, and topics relevant to business, such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
